items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Yeah I knew Billy very well. Great arranger.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jo Jones did the same thing. Louie Bellson too. And right now I'll take a drum solo and the first thing I'll think about is a tap dance routine, and that's how my drum solos come along. Or if you're used to playing for chorus girls, you just close your eyes and just think there's a whole gang of chorus girls in front of you dancing, and that's where your drum solo comes out. And it just makes sense like that, you know. Same with dancing. (HUMMING AND DRUMMING). You know things like that, the rhythm just…
I heard a story once, do you know a Billy tune called 'Upper Manhattan Medical Group'?
